cim: How Realpage. builds AI training with ChatGPT Work
cim_eredeti: How Realpage. builds AI training with ChatGPT Work
szoveg_eredeti: At Realpage., Austin Braham creates AI training for different teams, roles and skill levels. He uses ChatGPT Work to turn ideas, notes and source materials into complete enablement packages tailored to each audience. The result is more relevant, consistent education that helps colleagues put AI to work in their everyday jobs.
